# BrightRise Academy

> BrightRise Academy provides personalized, live one-on-one online tutoring for Kindergarten through Grade 10 students and families worldwide.

Canonical website: https://www.brightriseacademy.com

## About BrightRise Academy

BrightRise Academy offers one-on-one online learning support shaped around a student's grade, current understanding, schoolwork, curriculum, and goals. Families can book a free introductory tutoring trial. Lessons are available online for learners in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, India, and other time zones.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/): Personalized online tutoring for K–10 students.
- [Online tutoring](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/online-tutoring): The BrightRise tutoring approach.
- [Subjects](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/subjects): Overview of all subjects offered.
- [Grades](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/grades): Tutoring by student grade.
- [How it works](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/how-it-works): How to start tutoring.
- [Free trial](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/book-a-free-trial): Book a free introductory session.
- [Mental Math Challenge](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/mental-math-challenge): A free, interactive 10-question mental math game for children.
- [Learning Journal](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/blog): A free, printable learning reflection journal for children.
- [FAQs](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/faq): Answers about lessons, subjects, grades, and free trials.
- [Contact](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/contact): Contact BrightRise Academy.

## Subjects

- [Mathematics tutoring](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/math-tutoring): Number sense, fractions, algebra, geometry, and problem solving.
- [Science tutoring](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/science-tutoring): Biology, chemistry, physics, Earth and space, and scientific reasoning.
- [English tutoring](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/english-classes): Reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, and literature.
- [Coding classes](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/coding-classes): Beginner-friendly programming and computational thinking.
- [Social studies](https://www.brightriseacademy.com/subjects/social-studies): History, geography, civics, and social inquiry.

- Service type: live, personalized, one-on-one online tutoring.

- Trial: a free introductory session can be requested without a credit card.
